The main takeaway from our work is that
the superconducting state of the electron-doping Ba(Fe1-xCox)2As2 system is node-like and does not change with the doping level.
the superconductivity of Ba(Fe0,9Co0.10)2As2 is node-dominated, and the superconducting gaps on the electron- and hole-like Fermi surface sheets are comparable.
